working_definition: Mitotically amplifying male germ cells (mid-to-late spermatogonial stage) of the adult testis, annotated manually by testis experts; no FBbt id given by the authors.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell found in the spermatogonial cyst. It specifically expresses bag of marbles (bam), which is required for its differentiation (Witt et al., 2019).

justification: Stage bin of the spermatogonial lineage; FBbt has no mid-late proliferating stage term, so the cell type spermatogonium is used (broad). Secondary spermatogonium (first 4 mitoses) is a possible finer term but also covers early divisions, so it is not an exact denotation of the authors' mid-late bin.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Male germline cell during its first 4 mitoses. The end result of these mitotic divisions is a cyst of 16 primary spermatocytes.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Covers all four transit-amplifying mitoses, not specifically the mid-late bin.
